item.title: 26k-Mile 2001 Lincoln Town Car Signature at No Reserve
item.description: This 2001 Lincoln Town Car Signature was initially sold in Ohio and remained registered in the state through the selling dealer's acquisition in 2025. Finished in black and Medium Platinum over Deep Charcoal leather, the car is powered by a 4.6-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 1964 Vanden Plas Princess 4-Litre R
item.description: This 1964 Vanden Plas Princess is a first-year R variant that is powered by a 4.0-liter inline-six of Rolls-Royce design and is one of approximately 6,500 examples produced during a four-year model run that ended in 1968. It is finished in green over a cream leather interior that features polished walnut veneer accents, rear tray tables, and reclining front seats with separate center armrests. item.title: 27-Years-Owned 1995 Mazda RX-7 5-Speed
item.description: This 1995 Mazda RX-7 was acquired by the current owner in 1998, and it has 52k miles following history in California and Washington state. The car is finished in Brilliant Black over black leather, and it is powered by a twin-turbocharged 1.3-liter Wankel rotary linked to a five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. Equipment includes the Popular Equipment Package, pop-up headlights, fog lights, 16" five-spoke wheels, a cassette stereo, cruise control, and air conditioning.

Additional equipment includes a three-speed automatic transmission, a Whipple twin-screw supercharger, a Holley Dominator EFI ECU, and a four-link rear suspension along with disc brakes, front struts, and a 9" rear end from Strange Engineering. item.title: 1991 Acura NSX 5-Speed
item.description: This 1991 Acura NSX was acquired by the seller on BaT in July 2022 following long-term prior ownership in California and Idaho.
